name: pi-context-engineer
description: Context governor for Pi Fabric and Pi Fovea: taint-gates data flow, budgets selection, compresses results, offloads payloads, and records context cost.
author: pyan

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck src/*.ts bench/*.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf .tmp/pi-ce-build && tsc --outDir .tmp/pi-ce-build --rootDir src --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck src/*.ts
scripts.build:bench: rm -rf .tmp/pi-ce-bench && tsc --outDir .tmp/pi-ce-bench --rootDir . --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck src/*.ts bench/*.ts
scripts.verify: npm run build && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-hooks.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-adversarial.js
scripts.bench:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:bench && node .tmp/pi-ce-bench/bench/e2e.js
